_comment: G-007 field classification for every IOETI REST record. Classes and rules: docs/security/PII_CLASSIFICATION.md. Gate: scripts/pii_dto_audit.py.

classes.REFERENCE: ids, versions, codes, statuses, flags, fixed messages
classes.BUSINESS: commercial data about organizations, products, amounts, dates
classes.PERSONAL: names and roles that identify a person (people and individual accounts, users)
classes.RESTRICTED: contact details, identity numbers, personal money, free text about a person: never in a response
